payload.question: The last field fix follows your choice today: during a mid-session plugin reinstall, plumb's checks keep running on the previous copy until the new one is ready. A check that can't run writes one line to the project's session error log (adopted projects only). Land it after the others? You would then reinstall the plugin to pick it up.
